focus: Iteration 10: cross-check and ranking. Reopened the ten load-bearing citations, corrected eight drifted anchors, gave every section 12 open item a final verdict, ranked the confirmed gaps, grouped them into six work packages and named what is not worth building.
noveltyJustification: The ten reopened citations all held, so the substance is consolidation; the eight corrected anchors, the final verdict matrix, the ranking, the six packages and the no-build list are new synthesis.

label: The name path finding holds: prepare still resolves a Claude name from the transcript only, and the title readers now sit at context-usage.cjs:247 and :253 rather than :244 and :250.

The wrapper finding holds: append_name_arguments still adds --name with the hop count at skilled-loop:417-421, the --remote-control value table is at :590, the optional-value rule at :1080, and the replay append is at :776-777 rather than :783.
The guard finding holds: QUESTION_TOOL is AskUserQuestion at subagent-guard.mjs:25, pendingHandOver calls armableRecord at :65 and :78, and the pending test is at :84 rather than :82.
The parked-record finding holds: markDeferred is still called only in the background-task branch at stop-arm.mjs:143, and the withdraw policy still keys on record.deferredAt at withdraw.cjs:27-28.

The cleared-goal finding holds: the fallback still returns the first settable ancestor at relaunch-core.cjs:656, packetGoalIsSettable still reads only budget and an unticked box at :601, and latestGoalLogEntry still returns {latest, whole} at :590.
The stale-parent finding holds: the no-goal-entry fallback still proves no relation between the note's work and the chosen ancestor, so any older ancestor with an unticked criterion remains eligible.
The title-strip finding holds: name_stem still owns the strip at skilled-loop:286 and the hop still appends the receiver number at :421; only a name ending in the sender's own number is at risk.
The Codex finding holds with a corrected anchor: the no-packet reason is at relaunch-core.cjs:902, not :899, and the branch still returns no packet.

The killer-flake finding holds: the test still uses idleMs 400 and timeoutMs 450 at killer.test.cjs:787-788, and waitForIdle's transcript branch still loops on the deadline at killer.cjs:180 with the remaining-slice computation now at :198.

The parent-budget finding holds: the packet report prints packet_durable_chars=3993 and packet_budget=ok, the binding table's last row is at goal.md:81 rather than :65, the exception log is at :149, and extractBindingTarget is still at check-goal.cjs:165 and used at :259.

The phase 033 finding holds: the parent spec still says Draft at spec.md:49 while child 001 says Complete at its spec.md:23; a fresh strict validation remains UNCONFIRMED because the research boundary forbids it.

The sk-git finding holds: SKILL.md:322 still states the unconditional rebase rule, while the hook mints only when the replayed message lacks a Commit-Id, with HAS_COMMIT_ID at prepare-commit-msg:271 and :279 rather than :285-288.

The final ranking groups the confirmed gaps into six work packages: app-name continuity, hop-dialog safety, goal continuity, runtime coverage, reliability residue, and docs/metadata; the operator decisions that gate them are name precedence, dialog runtime scope, the goal-ending amendment, and build-versus-document for Codex.

No finding was reversed by the audit; eight citations drifted by 1 to 9 lines, and every claim survives its corrected anchor. The mobile write path, the app title and the --name versus --remote-control precedence remain UNCONFIRMED until live Run B.
Every open item of section 12 of the strategy file carries one of CONFIRMED, REFUTED or UNCONFIRMED with the deciding evidence.
Every confirmed gap in the final ranking names a smallest change (file and function), a test, and a runtime scope.
The mobile rename gap is real in code: a store-only rename is invisible to prepare because only the transcript is read.
The app-side title after a hop and the precedence between --name and a replayed --remote-control value remain unverified until Run B.
